senses.gloss: cloud with uneven surface (like scabs or swollen lumps), cumulus (which brings rain).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:12">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> (allegorical explanation), v. <cite ref="H00531"><he>חִזָּיוֹן</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:3:5">Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ</cite> bot., v. preced.—Bab.
Ib. מאי ח׳ what are ḥazizim (Zech. X, 1)? Answ. פורחות eruptions (defined: ‘a thin under a thick cloud’).

senses.gloss: [Readings vary between חזיז a. חִזִּין, pl. of חֵז] lichen, used as food (Lecantora esculenta).
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:20">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>כשות וח׳ וכ׳</he> the law of robbery does not apply to cuscuta and lichen.

senses.gloss: [Readings vary as ab.] young blades of grain used for pasture.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 5a:7">Taan. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>אוכל ח׳ מן התלמים</he> Ms. M. (some ed. <he>הזיז</he>) eats the young green from the furrows.
